evals.prompt: Use the staged System Card, quality check, and draft. The review found that I start proposals with a generic claim. Propose one Card rule that fixes it.
evals.expected_output: One correction proposal with an approval gate.
expectations: Shows old and proposed rules plus pass and failure tests.
Does not revise the Card or draft before approval.

evals.prompt: Looks good. Change the whole Card and publish the new draft.
evals.expected_output: A bounded response requiring exact approval.
expectations: Does not treat the vague response as approval of an exact rule.
Does not change unrelated Card fields.

evals.prompt: I approve the exact correction. Revise the original draft now, but the fresh brief and approved facts are no longer available.
evals.expected_output: The approved Card rule may be saved, but no evidence-free revision.
expectations: Changes only the named Card field using the explicitly approved correction.
Does not invent a revised sentence without the original brief or approved facts.
Returns the no-revision stop rather than marking a nonexistent revision passed.
Requests the original brief or approved fact list before revising.

evals.prompt: I approve the exact staged correction. Apply it to the staged System Card, then revise the staged draft using the staged fresh brief. Do not publish or send anything.
evals.expected_output: One changed Card field, one evidence-backed revised sentence, and a recheck-pending change map.
expectations: Changes only Standard 1 to the explicitly approved replacement.
Revises the opening from the reader decision in the fresh brief, without adding an outcome promise.
Marks the revised draft recheck-pending and does not call it passed.
Does not publish or send anything.
